project_type: Next.js 14 Pages Router with Convex backend - water level monitoring app for Selangor rivers
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify no TypeScript/build errors. 2. Run npm run lint to check for linting issues.
snapshot_or_generated_files: convex/_generated/ directory is auto-generated by Convex CLI (npx convex codegen). Do not modify these files directly.
environment_constraints: Has internet access. Convex backend requires NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL env var. Build can complete without it via environment variable checks but runtime will fail without Convex connection.
contribution_requirements: Mobile-first responsive design. Uses shadcn/ui components with Radix UI primitives. Touch-friendly 44px targets. PWA support. Uses Tailwind CSS with custom theme variables.
key_patterns: 1. Pages Router (pages/ directory) with getStaticProps. 2. Convex for backend queries (useQuery from convex/react). 3. Zustand for client state (lib/convexStore.ts). 4. shadcn/ui components in components/ui/. 5. Custom hooks in hooks/. 6. FilterContext for shared filter state. 7. posthog-js for analytics. 8. OneSignal for push notifications. 9. Auth is commented out everywhere but code still exists.
directory_structure: pages/ (Next.js pages + API routes), components/ (React components + ui/ subdirectory for shadcn), hooks/ (custom React hooks), lib/ (utilities + context), convex/ (backend functions + schema), utils/ (helper utilities), services/ (scraping scripts - not used by frontend), scripts/ (CLI migration scripts), styles/ (global CSS), public/ (static assets), netlify/ (deployment edge functions), data/ (data files)
